top_categories.workout_context: Gravel Grit 'n Grind's Swedish farm and forest gravel, UCI Gravel World Series forces constant power changes. Surge over the rough stuff, settle on the smooth, repeat for 83 miles.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Gravel Grit 'n Grind's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before August.
Gravel Grit 'n Grind's halland farm and forest gravel rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
At mile 60 of 83, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Gravel Grit 'n Grind. Train it until it feels boring.
At Gravel Grit 'n Grind, surges push you above threshold and you have to recover while still riding. Over-unders train exactly that.
When someone attacks on halland farm and forest gravel, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
How long can you hold 105% FTP before you blow? At Gravel Grit 'n Grind, that number decides whether you bridge or get dropped.
Short, max efforts are unavoidable. Punchy climbs, gap closures, attacks on halland farm and forest gravel. If you haven't trained them, you'll crack.
Two threshold sessions per week without the recovery cost of VO2max work. For 83 miles, sustainable FTP gains matter more than peak power.
Endurance with intensity spikes baked in. Exactly what 3,926ft of climbing on halland farm and forest gravel does to your power file on race day.
Varied gradients on halland farm and forest gravel demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.

race_overlay.nutrition: Target 40–60g carbs/hour for Gravel Grit 'n Grind’s 50 miles. Front-load calories in the first half. One bottle per hour minimum, more in heat.
race_overlay.terrain: Mixed terrain at Gravel Grit 'n Grind requires surface adaptability. Include weekly rides on mixed gravel to build confidence. Expect: gravel roads.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on Gravel Specific, Race Simulation, and TT Threshold to prepare you for 83 miles of halland farm and forest gravel in Halmstad, Sweden.
